S02.title: What it does
S02.headline: Four moments this is built for.
S02.sub: Not four features. Four times a phone is hardest to put down.

blocks.title: When you don't know where the week went
blocks.body: A week of honest numbers first. Nothing is blocked while we look — a starting line you didn't choose isn't worth much.

blocks.title: When your thumb is already on the icon
blocks.body: A short pause on the apps you pick, with your own words on the screen instead of ours.

blocks.title: When the pull arrives at 11pm
blocks.body: One tap, ninety seconds, works with no signal. Nothing is sent while you use it.

blocks.title: When you go over anyway
blocks.body: It goes in as history. It never zeroes a number you've built, and nobody is told.

blocks.title: What it isn't
blocks.body: It doesn't lock your phone, read your messages, see who you follow, or score you against anyone else.

S02.footer: Education and self-management support. Not a diagnosis or treatment.

S04.title: Your age
S04.headline: How old are you?
S04.sub: This sets a floor your limits can't drop below. It changes what LookUp is allowed to take away from you.

items.title: 18 or over
items.body: You set your own limits, as low as you want them.

items.title: 13 to 17
items.body: Same tools, with a floor underneath them.

items.title: Under 13
items.body: Chips instead of typing, and a grown-up on the account.

items.title: Prefer not to say
items.body: We'll use the 13 to 17 settings. Nothing is unlocked by answering.

blocks.title: What a floor means
blocks.body: Under 18, LookUp keeps at least 30 minutes a day available. Being cut off from friends is its own harm.

blocks.title: Under 13
blocks.body: No typing anywhere in the app. You'll pick your reasons from a list instead of writing them, and there's no note box to fill in.

blocks.title: Add a grown-up you trust
blocks.body: They'd see that you're using LookUp and your weekly total. Never your apps, your messages, your location, or what you wrote.

items: See a weekly total, and that you're still here
Change your limits, or read anything you wrote

S04.footer: We don't check this against anything. Saying you're older only removes a protection — it never adds a feature.

S06.title: Trigger map
S06.headline: When does it usually happen?
S06.sub: Pick what's true. Your baseline week already knows some of it, so a few are ticked — untick anything that's wrong.

blocks.title: What's usually underneath it
blocks.body: Same words we'll offer you during a pull, so they'll look familiar later.

blocks.title: 21:30 – 23:00, every night so far.
blocks.body: 78 opens a day, and the longest stretch starts once the house goes quiet. That's why In bed and After dinner are already ticked.
None of this is fixed. Every pull you log moves this map, and the tools we suggest move with it.

S06.footer: Kept on your phone. Not shared with anyone.

S10.title: Support
S10.headline: One person, and a sentence they'll understand.
S10.sub: Not a group. One person you'd actually text at 11pm.

items.title: Someone else
items.body: Pick from your contacts — we only read the one you tap.

items.title: No one for now
items.body: The rest of the plan works without this. You can add someone any time.

blocks.title: What Jordan would see
blocks.value: Can you talk for ten minutes?

blocks.title: When you'd want them
blocks.body: Optional. Nothing here sends on its own — it only decides when we offer.

blocks.title: Nothing is sent yet
blocks.body: When a moment comes, we show you the exact message first. You press send, or you don't. LookUp never texts Jordan by itself.

blocks.title: What Jordan never gets
blocks.body: Your minutes, your apps, your notes, your location, or a notification that you slipped.

S10.footer: Jordan isn't told they've been picked until the first time you send something.

S15.title: Guided reset
S15.headline: Stay with this for three minutes.
S15.sub: Breathe out for a little longer than you breathe in. If that's too much to think about, just watch the number.

blocks.label: BREATHE OUT SLOWLY
blocks.quote: You said: “I want my evenings back.”

blocks.title: Don't want the animation?
blocks.body: It can be a plain countdown, or numbers with no movement at all. Nothing here needs the ring to work.

blocks.title: Want something else right now?
blocks.body: You won't lose this reset.

S15.footer: Works offline · Nothing is sent, and nothing leaves your phone while this runs.

S16.title: How is it now?
S16.headline: How strong is it now?
S16.sub: Move the dot. “The same” and “worse” are real answers, and they're the useful ones.

blocks.body: This is how you felt, in your words. LookUp doesn't treat it as a clinical measurement.

blocks.title: Same, or stronger?
blocks.body: Then this wasn't the right tool tonight. That's information about the tool, not about you — we'll rank it lower and offer you something else next time.

blocks.title: Had enough of doing this alone?
blocks.body: Jordan, Maya, or a line that answers at any hour. No one is notified unless you choose.

S16.footer: Saves offline and syncs once · You can delete this event later

S24.title: Quiet phone
S24.headline: Make it a duller phone.
S24.sub: Each of these lowers how often the pull starts. None of them ask you to resist anything.

blocks.title: Fewer starts beats more resisting.
blocks.body: Most evenings don't begin with a decision. They begin with a coloured icon under your thumb. Move the icon and the decision never comes up.

blocks.title: Move the apps off your home screen tonight.
blocks.body: You open them most in bed. Three taps of distance is usually enough.

blocks.title: Take the colour out after 22:30
blocks.body: Grey from your quiet hours until morning. Your photos and camera go grey too — that's the honest cost of it.

blocks.title: Notifications in one batch
blocks.body: No badges, no previews, one delivery at 18:00. Calls and texts from people in your contacts are untouched.

items: Never blocked, in any setting here

blocks.title: All of it is yours to undo
blocks.body: Every change here can be reversed from your phone's own settings without opening LookUp. If we ever can't hand something back, we won't offer it.

S24.footer: On iPhone, LookUp opens the right settings page — you make the change yourself.

S25.headline: Short, plain, and dated.
S25.sub: Six pieces, none longer than a bus ride. Each one shows when it was last checked.

blocks.title: Boredom isn't a fault to fix
blocks.body: 6 min · reviewed July 2026

items: WHY A PULL FADES IF YOU WAIT

blocks.title: Why the dates are on the front
blocks.body: Anything that hasn't been checked in eighteen months comes down rather than sitting here looking current.

blocks.title: What this library won't do
blocks.body: These explain. They don't prescribe. Nothing here recommends a medicine, a therapy or a course of treatment, and nothing here knows your history.

blocks.title: If you want that conversation
blocks.body: It belongs with a qualified person. Maya replies within a day, and 988 answers at any hour.

S25.footer: Reviewed before it goes up, and dated so you can see how old it is.

S26.title: Progress

blocks.eyebrow: Two evenings went over, and both are still here
blocks.title: 5 August and 19 August.
blocks.body: Nothing was reset. You're still on day 19, both nights are in the average above, and the tall bar on Wednesday is one of them. We'd rather show you an honest chart than a flattering one.

blocks.title: It's still the same stretch.
blocks.body: Three of your four longest evenings started between 21:30 and 23:00 — the same window as your baseline week. The difference is they end sooner now.

blocks.title: Send this to Maya?
blocks.body: You'd read the exact file first: totals and adherence, no notes, no app names, no slip flags. Nothing moves until you press send.

S26.footer: Nothing on this screen has been shared. It only leaves your phone if you ask it to.

S28.title: Settings & privacy

blocks.title: Notifications
blocks.body: Detail is off. A reminder on your lock screen says “LookUp” and nothing else — not which program, not your minutes, not why. Anyone who picks up your phone learns that an app reminded you. That's all.

items: Gentle — a pause before you open

blocks.title: Export everything
blocks.body: A readable file plus a structured one, including anything you've deleted from view but not from the record. It stays on your phone unless you send it.

blocks.title: Delete everything
blocks.body: Completed, not hidden — your phone, our servers, and anything queued to sync. It can't be undone, and it ends your active programs.
Education and self-management support. It does not diagnose, treat or prescribe, and is not a substitute for advice from a qualified health professional.

S28.footer: Loosening a limit waits 24 hours. Tightening one takes effect straight away.
